notes.title: Original Challenge Restored!
notes.content: Thank you to everyone who has downloaded [i]Let me Paddle[/i]! In this update, I’ve reverted the game to its original, more difficult version to bring back the intense challenge. If you’re up for it, prepare yourself! I’ve also improved the Game Over screen for a better experience. Your support means the world to me—keep paddling and good luck with those sharks!
